open_questions.question: Does a second independent arbitrary mask allow copy rank below 32?

open_questions.first_step: Fix two small cubic masks; check whether the second partition splits a generic plane, then price the exact finite decoder graph before physical implementation.
open_questions.blocked_by: The current within-cell basis changes need not preserve both mask partitions; PR1482 covers only specific mask pairs.

open_questions.question: Can different reader and source one-mask codes beat 32?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The theorem requires a common cell partition and does not compare independent masks on the two sides.
open_questions.first_step: Choose distinct cubic masks with independent evaluation matrices and certify the 512-state rectangular coefficient graph, including zero-cost edges.
open_questions.blocked_by: A basis change that preserves the reader support need not preserve the source support; any algebraic improvement still needs full source/frame/restoration pricing.
